name: Delal a Ngibtal
description: A legendary marine serpent and ancestral spirit in Palauan mythology associated with the submerged village of Ngibtal and the origins of ocean tides.
appearance: Appears as a massive, luminous sea serpent winding through the turquoise waters and barrier reefs of Palau.
behavior: Guards the deep waters surrounding ancient Palauan settlements, watching over the ecological balance of the sea.
habitat: Barrier reefs and deep waters of Palau
cultural_significance: Water-spirit from Palauan mythology embodying respect for marine boundaries and ancestral heritage.
summary: A legendary marine serpent and ancestral spirit of Palauan mythology associated with deep waters and reefs.
fun_fact: Palauan oral traditions recount the profound transformation of Ngibtal and its guardian serpent into the living reef.
